entry.title: A week of Learning Solana #100DaysOfSolana
entry.summary:
I spent 7 days learning Solana wallets — here’s what actually clicked
I’ve mostly worked in Web2 stuff, so when I started Solana, I expected something like: create account set password get token-based auth or something But that’s not what happens at all. There is no “account creation” step. You just generate a keypair and… that’s your identity. First thing I did was generate a wallet in code: ` import { generateKeyPairSigner } from "@solana/kit"; const wallet = await generateKeyPairSigner(); That’s it. No email. No signup. No backend. Just a public key and a private key. At this point it honestly felt like “okay but where is the account actually stored?” Answer: nowhere. You are the account.
Next step was making it persistent. So instead of generating a new wallet every time, I saved it…
